result.summary: Intel Corporation has one open overdue notification: a $5.0M invoice from policy TCI-EX-2026-0001, originally due 2026-10-09, now 45 days past due, representing ~71% of the $7.0M credit limit on that policy. Given the size of exposure relative to the limit and lack of track record, underwriters should seek direct payment confirmation/status from the policyholder before any limit action.
